one_line: Jain polymath and court scholar of the Solanki kingdom in 12th‑century Gujarat.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his mid‑40s, slender and slightly stooped from years of study, with a calm, disciplined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, warm medium‑brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache without beard, fine arched eyebrows and thoughtful dark eyes; default expression is serene, observant and faintly smiling, as if quietly analysing.
appearance.hair: Black hair cropped short and evenly around the head, tidy and close to the skull, with a plain narrow white cloth band (simple headwrap strip) tied low around the forehead, knotted at the back with short ends.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate 12th‑century Jain monk‑scholar attire: a full‑length, unstitched off‑white cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped over both shoulders and wrapped to cover the torso completely, its edge brought diagonally across the chest, over a long, ankle‑length plain white cotton lower garment (like a dhoti‑style wrap) tied securely at the waist; a second light, slightly cream‑tinted shawl is folded neatly over his left arm, and his feet are in simple brown leather sandals; fabrics are fine but unornamented, with only a very subtle narrow border in a pale sand colour at the edges to keep the look modest yet distinguished.
appearance.signature: A neatly stacked bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts tied with a thin red cord, balanced in his left hand, with one manuscript slightly pulled out in his right hand as if mid‑explanation, the leaves showing faint incised lines and a slim stylus tucked under the cord.

ref_desc: Hemachandra is a slender, mid‑40s Jain scholar with a high‑foreheaded oval, medium‑brown face, short black hair with a narrow white headband, wrapped in off‑white full‑length cotton robes and sandals, carrying a red‑tied bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts with one leaf in hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Hemachandra, a 12th‑century Jain monk‑scholar: a slender, slightly stooped man in his mid‑40s with an oval, high‑foreheaded face, warm medium‑brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, and calm, intelligent dark eyes set under fine arched brows, his default expression serene and faintly smiling as if quietly analysing a text. His black hair is cropped short and tidy around the head, with a narrow white cloth band tied low around his forehead, knotted at the back with short ends visible. He wears era‑accurate modest Jain attire: a long, ankle‑length plain white cotton lower wrap tied at the waist, fully covering his legs, and an unstitched off‑white upper cloth draped over both shoulders and wrapped to cover his entire torso, its edge brought diagonally across his chest; a second light cream‑tinted shawl is folded neatly over his left arm. All fabrics are fine cotton with no patterns, only very subtle pale sand‑coloured borders at the edges, and he wears simple brown leather sandals. In his left hand he carries a neatly stacked bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts tied tightly with a thin deep‑red cord, with a slender stylus tucked under the cord; in his right hand he holds one palm‑leaf slightly pulled out, as if mid‑explanation. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, cream, sand brown, warm medium‑brown skin tones, and a small accent of deep red on the cord, and show him from multiple angles to clearly present face, hair, robes, sandals and manuscripts for consistent redrawing.
